g.text: Clients → Edge → BFF → App tier → Data / Events · sparse main flows

text.tspan: Web, mobile, and admin traffic hits CDN / WAF
WAF forwards to API Gateway and BFFs
BFFs aggregate domain services over gRPC / HTTP
Order reserves inventory and authorizes payment
Payment Service calls the card network
App Tier reads/writes owned data stores
Domain publishes to Kafka; Shipping / Notify consume
